resources.string: F*ck Shorts removes Shorts from the YouTube app. It reads the layout of the YouTube app (buttons, text, positions), notices which app is in front, takes screenshots for colors and your profile picture, places its own bar without Shorts over YouTube\'s bar, presses Back when a Short opens and, if you want, hides Shorts shelves. Everything it reads from YouTube stays on your phone. Internet is only used for subscriptions (Google Play, Superwall). It doesn\'t read passwords, messages or other apps.
